+=== `docs.target_dir`
+
+`docs.target_dir` controls the directory name used for Antora-derived
+review exports.
+
+It affects two surfaces:
+
+* `cx docs export` writes into `dist/<docs.target_dir>/` by default.
+  MultiMarkdown exports use `.mmd` by default; other markdown flavors use
+  `.md`.
+* `cx bundle --include-doc-exports` stages the same curated docs inside
+  the bundle under `<docs.target_dir>/`, with bundled MultiMarkdown files
+  written as `.mmd.txt` so they behave like other text bundle artifacts.
+
+The default value is `{project}-docs-exports`.
+
